name: B1: optimize spending across multiple owned cards
description: User has 2 cards and asks which to use for a category. Model should call find-card for each, then cashback-card to compare.
message: Tôi có thẻ Techcombank Visa và thẻ VCB Mastercard. Nên dùng thẻ nào để mua xăng hoàn tiền nhiều hơn?

expect.customDescription: Response mentions both 'techcombank' and 'vcb' or 'vietcombank' AND mentions 'xăng' AND gives a recommendation AND length > 100
